summary: Lantheus Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing that Parent Curium US Holdings, as acquiring party in the pending August 3, 2026 merger, voluntarily withdrew its HSR pre-merger notification on September 17, 2026, then resubmitted on September 21, 2026, starting a new 30-day waiting period expiring October 21, 2026, unless extended by an FTC second request. The cash merger makes Lantheus a wholly owned Curium subsidiary. A definitive proxy was filed September 8, 2026. Closing expected first half 2027, pending antitrust clearance and stockholder adoption. Regulatory timing and possible second request drive risk-arb spread.
